title: One full rotation
text: One full rotation around the circle is $$2\pi$$ radians, which puts you back at the location A found above.

title: Extrapolate
text: You can complete multiple full rotations and end up at the same location. This tells us that $$0$$, $$2\pi$$, $$4\pi$$, $$6\pi$$, ... are all equivalent radian measures.

title: Change directions
text: You can also rotate in the opposite direction, and end up back at the same point. This means that the angles are ..., $$-4\pi$$, $$-2\pi$$, $$0$$, $$2\pi$$, $$4\pi$$, $$6\pi$$, ... also written as $$2pin$$ where $$n$$ is any integer.
